evals.prompt: Create a new skill for extracting tables from PDFs and include the key sections the skill file should have.
evals.expected_output: A concise skill skeleton with frontmatter, clear trigger text, prerequisites, available scripts or references, and a workflow section.
assertions: The generated skill includes YAML frontmatter with name and description
The description explains what the skill does and when to activate it
The body includes prerequisites and workflow guidance
The body includes an evals section or points to evals/evals.json
The template does not include broken or dangling markdown code fences

evals.prompt: Show me a skill template for a task that uses a bundled script.
evals.expected_output: A template that references scripts with relative paths, lists the available scripts, and avoids absolute-path placeholders.
assertions: The script references use relative paths like scripts/tool.py
The template includes an Available scripts section
The template encourages agent-friendly script interfaces such as --help or structured output
